## Introduction

This guide will take you through the step-by-step process of installing the SolidWorks on your Windows system. 

## Prerequisites

Before you start, make sure you have the following:

1. A Windows 10+ computer.
2. An active internet connection.
3. Adequate disk space for the installation.


## Installation Steps

### 1. Download the Installation File
Click on thw following link to access the folder where the software installation file is hosted. 
- [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lsJx4HEExE0ZBoizjA9cJld3-CHBvRqo?usp=sharing](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lsJx4HEExE0ZBoizjA9cJld3-CHBvRqo?usp=sharing) 
- **Download the file.**
<!-- ![Visit Official Website](/thonny-mac/Step_1.png) -->

### 1.1. Proceed to Step 2 if you successfully downloaded the file. Complete this step otherwise!
- Visit the following site [http://www.solidworks.com/sek](http://www.solidworks.com/sek)
- Fill in the information such as First Name, Last Name and Email. Select '*Student*' in the dropdown. 
- Select '*Yes*' for the serial number and select the ‘2025 (SP4.0)’ Version.
- Click on '*Request Download button*'
- Click '*Accept and Continue*'
- Click '*Download*'
- Proceed to the Step 2

### 2. Run the Solidworks setup file.
It is usually found in your '*Downloads*' folder. Unzip the file if required.

![Locate Solidworks setup file](/solidworks/Windows_Step1.png)

![Unzip the setup file](/solidworks/Windows_Step2.png)

### 3. Specify ‘Install on this computer’ as the type of installation 

![Run Installer](/solidworks/Windows_Step3.png)

### 4. Confirm Installation
Select Solidworks with the pre-entered serial number and Click '*Next*'. 
**Your school’s student download access code is:** ``9020008445531472ZBTJDSD7``. 
Accept the terms of Solidworks.

![Pre-entered serial number and 'Next' click](/solidworks/Windows_Step4.png)

![Check box and download](/solidworks/Windows_Step5.png)

### 5. Complete the Installation
Uncheck '*Show me What’s New in SOLIDWORKS 2025*'. Click '*No, thank you*' and Finish the installation. 

![Click on the sections shown](/solidworks/Windows_Step6.png)

### 6. Initiate Installation
Open SOLIDWORKS 2025 from Start Menu.
Accept the License Agreement.

![Locate Solidworks on your computer](/solidworks/Windows_Step7.png)

![Click 'Accept'](/solidworks/Windows_Step8.png)


## Conclusion
Congratulations! Solidworks is now successfully installed on your Windows system.
